pirs.statement: Will the Riksdag pass the first reading of KU34 constitutional abortion protection before the September 2026 election, and does SD support both tracks?
pirs.trigger: SD official party statement on KU34 aborträtt track (expected week 20, before 15 May 2026) + Riksdag calendar entry for first reading debate

pirs.statement: Will the government present a climate proposition to Riksdagen before the summer 2026 parliamentary recess?
pirs.trigger: Government press release announcing climate proposition OR interpellation response confirming no proposition

pirs.statement: Will prop. 2025/26:263 (stärkt återvändandeverksamhet) pass Riksdagen without significant amendment despite V counter-motion HD024150?
pirs.trigger: SfU committee vote on HD024150 + Riksdag plenary vote on prop. 263

pirs.statement: Will the Tidö coalition maintain parliamentary majority (≥175 seats effective) through to the September 2026 election without confidence vote failure?
pirs.trigger: Any defection of SD/KD/L from coalition OR opposition confidence vote initiated
